title: Python String Methods Mastery
description: Python has a set of built-in methods that you can use on strings. All string methods return new values; they do not change the original string. Essential methods include 'upper()', 'lower()', 'strip()' (to remove whitespace), and 'replace()'. Mastering these is key for data cleaning.
example:
# Common String Operations
a = " Hello, World! "
print(a.strip()) # "Hello, World!"
print(a.lower()) # " hello, world! "
print(a.replace("H", "J")) # " Jello, World! "

# Splitting into a list
print(a.split(",")) # [' Hello', ' World! ']
